yes, same for us. happening since ~10h ago for our matches
This is likely because, on the final day of the Orbit Wars competition, a rush of last-minute submissions has temporarily strained the available resources.
How can i locally carry out test plays and check how my agent is doing ? Is there even a way? Or can i only check the performance on kaggle matchups?

I would also want to see if anyone explored this. From my understand local self-play will always a null test adapting to the actual field because the relative difference in variability is just too much.
